items.name: Clock
items.description: Clock resource provided by a mudpit burbler mine.

items.name: High-pass filter
items.description: Passes short waves and stops long ones, as sound through a narrow opening does. Found in openings through rock and in hollow trunks; it comes back half a day after you take it.

items.name: Oscilloscope
items.description: Shows a sound as a line, as a still pool draws the beat in rings. Found in ripple pools along streams; it comes back half a day after you take it.

items.name: Patch cable
items.description: Joins two jacks on a rack. Racks come with the spare cables their voice needs; these are for patches of your own.

items.name: Reed water purifier
items.description: A check dam of sticks and reeds with its rack in place. Build it across a laid stream; tuned, it lifts the water below it one level clearer.

items.name: Snail shell
items.description: An empty, high-spired snail shell of four whorls. Mounted in a rack it becomes a four-step sequencer: light the steps you want, patch a clock in, and take GATE and CV out.

items.name: Square wave
items.description: A square-wave primitive mined from a lightning bug, like coal in a factory builder. Use it in modular-synthesis recipes as a VCO waveform, LFO, or gate.
